name: Amasaki Ichigo
source:
Hobbies: Doing Discipline Committee activities
Likes: Relaxing when his sister's not around, milk
Dislikes: Everything unreasonable his sister tries to make him do

[url=/c53076]Ayame's[/url] younger brother who is a member of the Discipline Committee. She often treats him like trash, and their relationship has gotten even worse after Ichigo entered high school, so he sees her as a barbarian. Due to this, he has respect for [url=/c55449]Shinobu[/url] for being able to get along with Ayame.
